description:
## Goal
Remove repeated clean-ancestor traversal from rooted witness alternate-parent selection, preserving exact reachability and cycle rejection. Relevant membership edits should cost the actual changed branches plus necessary shared-path proof, not branch count times shared depth.

## Baseline evidence
Read-only inspection of ad0ac47d3 src/compiler2/pull/rooted.rs confirms RootedProducts::remove_edge filters every alternate candidate through below(candidate, removed_child); below follows parents to the seed independently each time. This predates48. No dedicated reparent/ancestor-performance ticket was found in bw search.
Production-reachable shape through the existing OwnershipProducers drive seam: retain S0→...→SD=T; T includes A1...AK and each Ai includes Ci. Settle, then add T→B where B includes every Ci and settle, preserving Ci witnesses under Ai. Leave prefix/T/B current; invalidate Ai,Ci and packaging P, and replace every Ai membership with empty. Each Ai completion repairs Ci to B. For each child, below(B,Ci) traverses the same D+2 clean nodes, giving K*(D+2) checks. This is a source-derived count, not a completed instrumented runtime RED.

## Scope and dependency boundary
48 separately introduced an admission-time ancestry scan on the same shape. That NEW cost is a48 blocker and cannot be deferred here. This ticket owns the preexisting below/alternate-selection work only, after48 lands; if48 naturally removes it, retain only the necessary remaining proof/docs rather than duplicate machinery. Keep existing typed deterministic alternate choice unless evidence permits a semantic-preserving simplification. No identity/display-string shortcuts, independent graph authority or permanent clearance cache.

## TDD and acceptance
- Pin the real retained drive shape at D=K8/32/64 before changing the baseline seam. Count all candidate checks and ancestor visits over the entire membership-repair request; keep them distinct from48 admission/cursor work.
- Preserve alternate support, cycle rejection, detach/reattach, seed reachability, unaffected branch retention and exact owner withdrawal. Add a back-edge alternate that must not retain an unsupported cycle.
- Demonstrate shared-prefix work is not multiplied by K, with unchanged/unrelated requests doing no new work. No shifted work hidden in uncounted upkeep or new per-request graph scan.
- Preserve healthy semantic outputs, generations, allocations where equal, and byte-identical backend/CLIF artifacts; inspect all causal-work differences without offsetting increases elsewhere.
- Collapse or reuse existing witness proof mechanics when possible; remove superseded scanner/helper and temporary instrumentation after the cutover. Coherent docs, implementation subagent, ticket-scoped cold review, one commit/close and prior-CI-gated push.

This is a required epic-tail issue, not authorization to leave48 regressions in place.

## Current implementation boundary
Selected from bw ready after49 commit/close/push because higher-priority53 awaits the explicit duplicate-type source policy. Base is9a66849631f6e4a92650445bb360bbc6831e0315; source/index clean except three preserved unrelated untracked measurement paths.49 exact CI34036595774 is active, so51 may implement and verify but cannot push until49 succeeds.

Root reread the current rooted witness implementation and docs. The preexisting scanner remains: RootedProducts::remove_edge filters each alternate through below(candidate,key), which walks candidate parents independently.48s sparse DirtyWitness/active-prefix index accelerates dirty-demand traversal and admission; it is not a general ancestry authority and does not answer clean alternate cycle checks.51 must not repurpose sparse dirty state as full reachability. Existing typed semantic minimum and transactional add-before-remove behavior remain current contracts.

Open-PR inventory was rechecked. Only stacked base PR110 overlaps fact-engine documentation; its headc2c723c63afdbda22078bb0a164cb313b8c7dfa8 is already an ancestor. No other open PR touches rooted.rs/rooted tests or the two relevant docs, so there is no concordant source implementation to import.

Implementation must first produce a genuine current-base RED through the retained OwnershipProducers/drive seam at D=K8/32/64, with separately observed candidate checks and ancestor visits and exact semantic controls passing before the work bound. Investigate the actual completion boundary before choosing cache lifetime: a solution scoped too narrowly to one remove_edge is insufficient if the repeated shared prefix spans multiple committed members. Prefer deriving cycle safety from the existing witness tree or a transient proof that is invalidated exactly by reparenting; do not add a retained ancestor graph/index, global scan, display identity, blanket cache, or shifted uncounted upkeep. Collapse the below scanner and temporary probes after cutover. Implementation subagent owns source/tests/docs only; root owns measurements, bw/index/commit/close/push and independent proof. Fresh ticket-cold review remains required.

## Genuine current-base RED
The unchanged production algorithm was exercised through the retained OwnershipProducers drive seam. Immutable failing log: /tmp/fz-tfn51-prefix-red.log; PTY session 98670; exit 101; RED diff SHA-256 87102237af28ec0210a232ffdb3450fb7d917f181a52c87767c4c1a061c0baf1. Observed (depth=width, candidates, ancestor visits, required bound): (8,8,80,56), (32,32,1088,200), (64,64,4224,392). Before the final work assertion failed, the test proved the existing48 admission bound, one evaluation and stable generation per affected owner and child, stable prefix/alternate Rc dependencies, exact obsolete owner membership/support withdrawal, and unchanged/unrelated zero repair work. Exactly K committed-owner repair reports prove the repeated scans span K ordinary ProductCompletion::Single completions inside one real drive; remove_edge-local or completion-local caching is insufficient. The instrumentation is causal and the production algorithm remains unchanged at this RED boundary.

Before production implementation, extend the RED with an asymmetric long reused-candidate path and stale-proof invalidation. The final model must remove repeated shared proof work beyond the symmetric fixture, account for all proof construction/invalidation/upkeep, retain an independent simple randomized oracle, and must not trade the old walk for hidden hashing, cloning, allocation, broad scans, or a second ancestry authority.
title: Eliminate repeated ancestor scans during rooted alternate-parent repair
